name: Midnight Chasers: Highway Racing
creator: Midnight In-dev
redeem: Launch Midnight Chasers: Highway Racing and press Play once the menu finishes loading.
Click the yellow Store button in the bottom-left corner of the screen, just under the Spawn button.
Select the Codes tab along the top of the Store window.
Type or paste the code into the text box exactly as written and click Redeem.
notes:
Midnight Chasers: Highway Racing is a no-hesitation traffic driving game from the Roblox group Midnight In-dev. You pick a car or motorcycle, drive onto a busy highway, and weave between traffic at high speed to earn cash, which you spend on new vehicles and upgrades. Players also use the open highways and city streets for casual cruising, races with friends, and car meetups.

Codes in this game almost always pay out cash, usually 30,000 per code, which shortens the grind toward faster cars. The developers tie new codes to like milestones, typically one every 10,000 likes named after the count (ThanksFor980k, for example), and announce them in the game description, their Discord server, and on X.

faq.q: When is the next Midnight Chasers code coming out?
faq.a: The game description says the next code arrives at 1 million likes. New codes usually come at like milestones and are named after the count, like ThanksFor980k.

faq.q: Where is the code box in Midnight Chasers?
faq.a: Click the yellow Store button in the bottom-left corner, just under the Spawn button, then open the Codes tab at the top of the Store window.

faq.q: Is there a way to earn more cash on top of codes?
faq.a: Yes. Joining the game's Roblox group, Midnight In-dev, gives a 25% cash boost, and the VIP gamepass gives a 50% cash boost.
